messages:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT — sustained org-level QPS spike detected for org "Silverline" (org_id=sl-4471). 12x baseline for 5m, p95 latency > 3s, tail 5xx increasing. Paging oncall.

jax: ack. i'm on it, pulling org dashboard + tracing.

jax: looks like most traffic is hitting /v1/chat.stream on model-chat-xl, high number of concurrent streams from one key (sl-key-7) and many short reconnects from several others.

li (oncall): joining. i see memory ejections on model-chat-xl host pool and a spike in prefetched KV misses. some backends returning 503s.

nina: cs, you able to reach out to Silverline?

cs-evan: pinged their oncall slack. they say a scheduled data ingestion started at 02:03 UTC and they underestimated concurrency for streaming transforms. they are watching and say they can pause if we apply a throttle.

jax: decision needed: quick protective action is org-scoped quota cap + temporarily disable long streaming to reduce continuous KV pressure. we can also provision ephemeral capacity but that will be billable.

li: prefer graduated control rather than hard 429s. plan: (A) cap sustained token rate and per-key concurrency, (B) disable streaming-long feature flags for the org for 30-45m to avoid long-lived KV locks, (C) set alert if any of their keys exceed burst threshold.

ops-bot: preparing command.

```
# applying emergency org quota and feature toggle
opsctl org-quota set --org sl-4471 --sustained 25tps --burst 400 --per-key-concurrency 4 --ttl 45m
opsctl feature-toggle set --org sl-4471 --feature streaming-long --state disabled --ttl 45m
```

deploy-bot: org quota & feature-change submitted by jax: sl-4471 sustained=25tps burst=400 per_key_concurrency=4 ttl=45m; streaming-long=disabled ttl=45m. Audit ID: AID-1942-9.

li: monitoring after change. initial metrics: platform p95 down from 3.2s -> 1.2s, 5xx rate reduced. we do still see some queued streams but no new OOMs.

nina: sending customer note template to Evan for approval: "We applied a temporary quota and disabled long streaming to prevent platform-wide impact. If you need a short-term burst, we can provision a paid ephemeral pool — let us know."

cs-evan: Silverline requested a temporary burst lift for one key (sl-key-7) to finish the job within 20m. they're willing to accept charge. please advise.

infra-bot: ephemeral pool possible in region-eu at 60% utilization. estimated cost estimate: ~$1.2k/hr for requested spec. finance-bot will need to tag this.

finance-bot: automated note — any ephemeral provisioning must include billing tag 'ephemeral-burst' and approval from finance channel. manual exception possible for customer-critical incidents.

jax: two choices: (1) keep soft limits + ask customer to backoff, (2) provision ephemeral pool and temporarily allow sl-key-7 elevated burst while keeping others throttled. prefer (1) unless customer insists.

cs-evan: customer insists they must finish within 20m and will accept charges. they asked if we can lift burst for just sl-key-7 while keeping streaming-long disabled org-wide. is that safe?

li: we can create per-key whitelist for burst allowing sl-key-7 higher burst but still enforce per-key concurrency limits. that isolates risk. will need infra to attach key to ephemeral pool or bump quota for that key only.

ops-bot: sample command to allow key-level temporary lift:
```
opsctl key-quota set --key sl-key-7 --burst 2000 --sustained 120 --duration 20m --note "customer-paid-burst"
```

deploy-bot: key-quota change queued: sl-key-7 burst=2000 sustained=120 ttl=20m (requested by cs-evan). Pending finance tag.

finance-bot: please include billing approval. tagging #finance for manual sign-off.

jax: i'm holding on actual apply until finance confirms. we'll keep org-wide streaming-long disabled.

nina: monitoring shows p95 stable and Silverline confirming they paused some jobs; still some active streams but within limits.

finance-bot: #finance approved temporary burst (ticket FIN-843). billing tag auto-attached. you may proceed.

deploy-bot: key-quota change applied: sl-key-7 elevated burst active for 20m. Audit ID: AID-1942-10.

li: watch mode on. initial effect: their long job finishes and we see their connection count drop at 02:21 UTC. platform-wide p95 remains ~1.1s. no new 503s on model-chat-xl.

jax: handing off monitoring to nina for 30m while i go offline. nina takeover acknowledged.

nina: taking over. will escalate to infra if host mem pressure >85% or 5xx > 0.5%.

jax: follow-ups assigned:
- eng-ml: add per-key burst detector and auto-soft-throttle (owner: eng-ml).
- eng-runtime: investigate model-chat-xl mem ejections with long streams (owner: eng-runtime).
- ops: add explicit workflow for per-key temporary paid lifts (owner: ops).
- cs: update customer-facing doc about when to request ephemeral bursts (owner: cs).

cs-evan: i've sent customer comms and they thanked us for the quick help. they'll schedule big jobs during a dedicated window next month and asked for a contact for reserved capacity.

deploy-bot: elevated key-quota expired after 20m automatically. Audit ID: AID-1942-10 (expired).

nina: confirming all policies rolled back except org streaming-long still disabled until TTL. org metrics stable.

ops-bot: streaming-long toggle expiry scheduled at 02:55 UTC.

jax: marking incident as mitigated. will file a short postmortem and include timeline + cost of ephemeral lift. assigning postmortem to eng-oncall + cs-ops.

-- end of thread --
